chunks: What Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ja'far ibn Bashir, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, who said:

I heard Aba al-Hasan عليه السلام saying concerning a man who returns from his journey at the time of salat: he said, if he does not fear the passing of the time, then let him perform it complete; but if he fears the exit of the time, then let him shorten.

key_terms.خُرُوجَ: the ending or expiration of the prayer time
key_terms.فَلْيُتِمَّ: let him perform the prayer in full
key_terms.فَوْتَ: the missing or lapse of the prayer time

ai.seo_question: If a traveler arrives home during prayer time, should he pray full or shortened salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a traveler returning home during the time of salat. If there is sufficient time remaining, he should offer the prayer in full; if he fears the time will end, he should pray in shortened form.
